subject: Discovery synthesis + exec checkpoints for Helix pilot
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@helixsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery synthesis + exec checkpoints for Helix pilot

Hi Marta — thanks again for the time today. Quick synthesis from our side and a proposed exec-checkpoint plan (attached MPA + SLA + pricing):

TL;DR (pain → pilot goal):
- Pain: high latency on user-facing inference and unpredictable per-token cost when scaling to live traffic.
- Goal: 8-week pilot to validate latency < 150ms p95 for interactive flows and 30% cost reduction vs current provisioning assumptions while preserving response quality.

What we captured on the call:
- Primary stakeholders: Marta (Head of ML), Tom (Platform Lead), Procurement (copy).
- Data scope: ~1.2M monthly requests, mixed short/long prompts (avg seq len ~600 tokens).
- Constraints: data residency within US, SOC 2 evidence required, no external model weights uploaded to third-party storage.

Proposed milestones & owners (please confirm or edit):
1) Pilot kickoff / access provisioning — target: 2026-11-08 — Owner: Helix (Marta), Redwood (Rafael)
2) Data onboarding & sample validation — target: 2026-11-22 — Owner: Helix (Tom), Redwood (Ben)
3) Performance & cost tuning (batched endpoints, quant profiles) — target: 2026-12-06 — Owner: Redwood (Marissa)
4) User validation + exec check (decision meeting) — target: 2026-12-13 — Owner: Helix execs & Redwood AE

Open items we flagged on the call:
- Procurement timeline & PO trigger (Marta to confirm who owns).
- Any internal blackout dates for Helix execs between 12/10–12/20.
- Whether Helix wants a shadowed production copy during pilot (adds infra/time).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (MPA workbook with milestone rows), redwood-pilot-SLA.pdf (SLA stub), pricing-estimate-Helix-2026.csv (initial ballpark). Also dropped a Drive link below.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm milestone dates/owners or send edits (by EOD Fri 10/23).
2) I’ll update the MPA and send a one-page exec summary for your leadership.
3) Schedule a 30-min kickoff once dates are locked (I can book once we have procurement contact).

If that works, I’ll update the MPA and loop Marissa to finalize the pricing line items.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
